name: NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT - MAY 28, 2024
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF
  ADJOURNMENT

Farrah N. Khan  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Regular
Mayor  Meeting of the Irvine City Council of Tuesday, May

Vice Mayor  Said meeting will be held in the City Council
